decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain and sits close to the core shop offer, and with the industry growing and the firm hiring there is no shortfall against aspirations and enough slack to keep it, although the earlier pruning of similar plugins and its absence from the website since 2020 raise some risk.
The ERP interface plugin supports the firm's end-to-end and multichannel direction and client retention, so it likely meets aspirations and does not call for problemistic search.
